{{Quote|Good news! The maestro just contacted us and has agreed to attend the Arts Jubilee! However, there is a slight complication. His favorite riding gualama has escaped from its stable and the maestro wants it returned safely. Do you think you could do that?|Hefsen Zindalai|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Graywind''' was a [[Gualama/Legends|gualama]] owned by a [[Gender/Legends|male]] maestro during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Erroneous depictions of Graywind the gualama]]
Graywind was a creature in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Although Graywind was identified as a gualama in the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue, the creature actually spawned under the generic "farmer" template, resulting in the so-called gualama's appearance being randomized under one of 120 possible [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Graywind could appear as included [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] of either gender, and [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]], [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]], [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] of the male gender. This article assumes that these randomized humanoid depictions are erroneous, and that Graywind is [[canon]]ically a gualama in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
